tha-ap456:1.1: Tiṇukkadhāriya.] Padumuttarassa Buddhassa bodhiyā pāda-v-uttame / pasannacitto sumano tayo ukke adhārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap456:2.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yo 'haṃ ukkam adhārayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ukkadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap456:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Tiṇukkadhāriyo thero i. g. a-ti.
